text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bound by nothing—free!
That is my dream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Spring)! This is it.
Only by running unconstrained on this stage can I truly shine!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Raise the vibes, hype myself up!
I am the strongest, feeling my absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Party animal, party animal, party animalll!
Party soul~! Say, yeaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, BFF! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"All riiiight☆ That's the spirit!
Ditch the gloomy mood and blast them with a killer greeting♪"
As if fighting against something, Mejiro Palmer rolled her shoulders and pumped herself up as she made her way down the underground tunnel. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Here it is, the Spring Tenno Sho...
The grand stage that every Mejiro Umamusume aims for...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(On that stage... finally, I'm here!
Today, I can stand beside her as an equal!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? That's... McQueen and Ryan.
Here they come!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have come this far aiming for this place.
To me—it is the most sacred of places.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, the finest run.
And a glorious Shield for the Mejiros!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I know this is an important race for McQueen. I know that, but...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a Mejiro too! I won't back down!
Further forward, right to the center of my dreams!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro McQueen. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Is their aura... totally different?
A whole level or two above anything before. So this is the Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Pull a party animal move... right here?
Right after everyone gave dead-serious greetings...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Still, it doesn't matter!
I am free! Free... I am truly free...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I can do whatever I want!
I can hype it up as hard as I like! That's how it's supposed to be! So...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Meji... Meji... Mejiro—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, go get 'em, Palmer-chin☆
Hype it up big time--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Each of them is staking what matters most to them
on this race.
Especially McQueen.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Compared to that, what about my feelings...?
My dream, my pride... what of them?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Meji... ro...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm... Mejiro Palmer.
Pleasure to meet you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hu... Palmer-chin...
A fizzled-out greeting. The venue's excitement remained at its peak as always, but amidst it all—
A young girl's true self was swallowed up and sunk beneath formality and status.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Not yet, we don't know for sure yet...
Not yet, we can't be sure yet...

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't move the way I wanted in the paddock.
Even so—

You never know until the race happens.All I can do is pray that Mejiro Palmer
can run just the way she wants to.
